title: Self-registered user can train/delete ML models (missing RBAC)
summary: Prove JWT authenticates but train/celery-task/delete have no role checks. Do not delete production models.
steps: Map POST /api/v1/train/, DELETE /api/v1/celery-task/, POST celery-task / optimize / logixtwin-train.
If signup is open: create ONE throwaway account. Otherwise use a mapped low-priv token.
compare_requests that identity vs a documented admin-only sibling on train/delete/celery.
PASS if the self-reg/low-priv session is 200/202/204. Prefer OPTIONS/authz or one tiny canary train.
Do not delete production models. Do not dump training datasets. Do not inject pickle/code into Celery.
Open signup is the internet exposure, not a second finding.
pass_signals: Self-registered or low-priv session can train, delete, or queue ML/Celery jobs
